notes.title: Abacus is now officially RELEASED!
notes.content:
[b]Well, it's been a long road.[/b]

Ten years in development; one year of Early Access. Now, it's finally over.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37187379/2b75bb00d90efc0ba0356596f030597c66c305d8.png[/img]

If you've been following the Early Access releases and you're wondering what's changed in this release... it's a big one!

[list]
[*]Added difficulty levels to Story Mode
[*]Added Signs
[*]Added new music tracks for Cave world
[*]Added new music tracks for Castle world
[*]Added new music tracks for Final Boss
[*]Added new music track for the Virtumart
[*]Added new Castle graphics
[*]Added compass arrows to Flags in CTF
[*]Added visual indicator for Heat effect
[*]Added tooltips in the editor
[*]Added new items to the Shop
[*]Improved Raven / Vulture AI
[*]Minor tweaks to several levels
[*]Minor graphical improvements
[*]Tweaked Shop costs
[*]Increased Knight aiming speed
[*]Reduced Ice Mage health
[*]Fixed crash in editor when trying to edit an invalid entity
[*]Fixed Final Boss dropping a Star when they've all been collected
[*]Fixed Dragon killing itself by flying out of bounds
[*]Fixed Worm sometimes failing to emerge
[*]Fixed Knights not blocking projectiles
[*]Fixed Double Jump icon missing from the Shop
[/list]

I would like to say a huge thank you to everyone who has supported me during this time - our playtesting sessions have been enormous fun and absolutely invaluable. I am really pleased with how the game has turned out. It's lightyears away from how it looked even just one year ago.

I really hope you enjoy it!

If you have any comments, questions or suggestions, please drop them in the Steam forum and I will endeavour to respond as soon as possible.

notes.title: Team games now available, including Capture the Flag!
notes.content:
It's been a while since the last update, but fear not, development is still very much ongoing! Now that the nuts and bolts of the game have been thoroughly tightened and battle-tested, work on much more exciting features can begin - which leads us to one of the biggest and most game-changing updates yet!

[b]Team Support[/b]
[list]
[*] Both Deathmatch and KOTH modes now support up to 4 teams
[*] For kill-based Deathmatches, victory is determined by the team total
[*] For life-based Deathmatches, victory is determined by the last team standing
[*] Team-specific spawn points can now be placed in the editor
[*] Players are coloured according to their team
[*] Players cannot hurt their teammates
[/list]

[b]Capture the Flag[/b]
[list]
[*] New game mode for 2 teams
[*] Comes with 2 new levels
[*] New levels can be made in the editor
[/list]

[b]Game Mode Enhancements[/b]
[list]
[*] Deathmatch levels can now support wrap-around autoscroll!
[*] KOTH countdown timers are now displayed on the HUD
[*] Flags added to KOTH maps to show who owns the capture point
[*] Added a sound when the capture point is taken
[/list]

[b]New Levels[/b]
[list]
[*] Deathmatch: Highlands
[*] KOTH: Outpost
[*] CTF: Library
[*] CTF: Lagoon
[/list]

[b]Redesigned Shop[/b]
[list]
[*] Each item now has a description
[*] Better support for small resolution
[*] A picture speaks a thousand words...
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37187379/c0348c9b98ee0b4bad1852e021d07403afb5802d.png[/img]

[b]... and loads more![/b]
[list]
[*] Graphical enhancements
[*] Balance tweaks
[*] Bugfixes
[*] See the readme for full details!
[/list]

notes.title: Play with Steam friends!
notes.content:
[h1]Abacus v0.26.0 is here![/h1]

Work on Abacus is progressing well, and the new version adds some meaty features. Without further ado, let's take a look!

[h2]Steam Lobbies[/h2]

Now you can jump into a game with your Steam friends with ease - no IP address or port forwarding required.

[h2]Multiple Save Slots[/h2]

You can now create as many save games as you like, and view a summary of your progress on the save select screen.

[h2]Revamped Scorcher[/h2]

The Scorcher has been heavily revamped - now you can expect more flames, and less lag! What's more, the flames now set players on fire, allowing for hit and run attacks. Flames cannot be blocked by the Shield, making the Scorcher a good counter for blocking players.

[h2]... and much more![/h2]

This release also adds a number of bugfixes and quality of life improvements.

See the readme for more details.

notes.title: More Multiplayer enhancements!
notes.content:
[b]Lobby Revamp[/b]

[list]
[*] Level preview
[*] Joining players can see game parameters
[*] Player names shown in colour
[*] Messages when players join or leave
[*] Pre-game countdown
[*] Players automatically rejoin the lobby after a game
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37187379/76c7d1721795d1cf499f2b267fda17807ebde6c3.png[/img]


[b]New Deathmatch Levels[/b]

[list]
[*] 7 new maps including 4 fan-made maps!
[/list]

[b]Weapon Tweaks[/b]

[list]
[*] Rainbow Bombs can no longer kill instantly and look nicer (!)
[*] Rainbow trails have been shortened, to make them less intrusive
[*] Bees home in on nearby enemies
[*] Scorcher damage reduced, and delay between firing modes reduced
[/list]

And of course you can now [b]TELEFRAG[/b] other players!

See the readme for full details.
